integrity: The infinite statement is proved by a matrix congruence and an exact 2-adic valuation identity. The included finite checker is supplementary and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the index block 0 <= n < 2^k and leading-bit lengths 1 <= r <= k-2 only.
It does not establish a short-prefix distribution law or uniformity for r > k-2.
Literature comparison was targeted rather than exhaustive; absolute priority is not certified.
title: Exact leading-bit uniformity for Pell residues
